cases.assertion: A verified runtime with fresh matching evidence can be selected.
A scaffold-only runtime cannot be selected as production verified.
A verified capability whose evidence is older than policy is rejected.
A capability with a mismatched evidence hash is rejected.
A graph edge referencing an unknown node is rejected.
A replay bundle fails after a bound artifact is changed.
A browser-review candidate belonging to another task is rejected.
A human-review semantic warning remains visible and is not converted into approval.
A generic Motion IR intent produces a deterministic low-specificity warning.
A context hash change between adjacent scenes is reported as continuity drift.
A fix plan is handoff-bound and contains a selective rerun scope for its findings.
A UI-context animation over 500 ms produces a non-blocking performance budget warning.
A Motion IR below 30 FPS produces a non-blocking frame-rate warning.
Linear easing in a UI-context track produces a non-blocking perceptual warning.
An explicit none reduced-motion policy produces a non-blocking accessibility risk warning.
The semantic lint benchmark records rule coverage and passes when p95 execution remains below threshold.
